'''Bert Claessen'''<ref name="dt-19200">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19200 Death Star EPP Assault], DeckTech (Bert "MisterFett" Claessen, 3 October 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19200/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19200/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech and Game Players Network handle '''MisterFett'''<ref name="gpn-147">[https://web.archive.org/web/20051102154456/http://gameplayersnetwork.com/card/decks.asp?gm=starwars&id=147 Draw out the shield.], Game Players Network (Misterfett, 7 December 2001), Wayback Machine copy.</ref>) posted a [[Dark]] [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course For Alderaan]] list on DeckTech in October 2001. Claessen also published one constructed list on [[Game Players Network]] in December 2001.
